source_coordinate_correspondence.rationale: Review stable realization identity separately from node naming and admitted type identity.
The record has no revision field; schema_version and Artifact Type version cannot substitute for Implementation revision.
Resolve the technical owner, role, principal and bounded authority independently.
Nomination is distinct from effective lifecycle, history and deployed runtime state.
No source revision or source-binding coordinate is present in this closed carrier.
environment_contract_ref and implementation_kind are not accepted build or deployment posture maps.
A nominated entrypoint may represent one interface; complete interface membership needs an accepted map.
Resolve evidence contents, applicability and purpose without treating schema references as conformance proof.
Resolve actual applicability and boundaries beyond a nonempty scalar.
No direct selected-use record is supplied by this carrier.
A type-level exact Definition binding is not an authenticated per-use version resolution.
No separate use scope or narrower-scope containment coordinate is present.
